context: Account pages and the header: the GitHub sign-in button and the sign-in page title ("Ingia kwenye Jifunze").
Account pages: the sign-out button and page ("Toka", "Umetoka kwenye akaunti").
The header link "Akaunti" and every account page; also used for a GitHub account ("akaunti ya GitHub").
Recovery page: the restricted 15-minute session after a recovery code ("Kipindi hiki kinaisha baada ya dakika 15").

Welcome, sign-in, account and recovery pages; plural "misimbo ya kurejesha" (m-mi class). Object concord -i- throughout: the required confirmation is "Nimeihifadhi" (not "Nimezihifadhi"), and "Iweke mahali pa siri".
Account home: the linked sign-in identity, shown as "Njia ya kuingia" (sign-in method) rather than a literal "utambulisho".
Recovery page: "Badilisha GitHub", replacing the lost GitHub identity with another one.
Account home: confirming with GitHub again before new recovery codes ("thibitisha kwanza kuwa ni wewe").
